programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: High Rollers
programme.desc: The risks are twice as high in this sequel to the 2024 crime action. Mason (John Travolta) and his crew attempt a high-stakes casino heist to save his kidnapped girlfriend.

programme.title: Force Of Nature: The Dry 2
programme.desc: A captivating, suspenseful sequel to the book-inspired 2020 hit The Dry. Five women go on a hiking retreat, but when one vanishes, Detective Aaron Falk must untangle the mystery.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: A bumbling star-studded crime comedy. Three friends conspire to murder their horrible bosses. Their half-brained scheme backfires, leaving them trying to fix their mess.

programme.title: Let Him Go
programme.desc: A star-studded cast leads this book-inspired 1960s Western thriller. A grieving couple tries to reclaim their only grandson, but things quickly spiral out of control.

programme.title: Abomkhulu
programme.desc: After a crime committed for SA's liberation struggle 30 years ago, three childhood friends are set free. They embark on a journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Headspace
programme.desc: When a team of aliens is stranded in a teenage boy's brain, they must enlist his help to save the Earth from Zolthard, an intergalactic villain who's stuck in the school principal's head.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart earned an Oscar nomination for portraying Princess Diana in this true story-based film about when she divorced Prince Charles during the Christmas holidays.

programme.title: R.I.P.D.
programme.desc: Men In Black fans will love this supernatural action movie. Ryan Reynolds and Jeff Bridges are part of a secret police department charged with fighting the undead.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Greg has to prove himself to his father-in-law Jack once more, as he tries to juggle two jobs and two kids.

programme.title: There's A Zulu On My Stoep
programme.desc: A classic comedy about prejudice. Two boys form an unlikely friendship in apartheid South Africa. When they meet again as adults, they go from one misadventure to another.

programme.title: Minions: The Rise Of Gru
programme.desc: A side-splitting prequel to the smash-hit animated franchise. The untold story of one twelve-year-old's dream to become the world's greatest supervillain.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
programme.desc: A star-studded voice cast (Ben Stiller, Chris Rock), loads of action, superb visuals and plenty of gags ensure the third attempt by the animals to return to NYC is a win.

programme.title: Supercell
programme.desc: Fans of Twister will be taken by this danger-filled storm movie. A teenage boy runs away to follow in his father's footsteps, legendary storm chaser Bill Brody.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Yimou Zhang helms this historical fantasy starring Matt Damon. An elite force of warriors must save humanity from a horde of monstrous creatures.

programme.title: Skyscraper
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson puts his body on the line in this heart-thumping action film. A security expert infiltrates a burning skyscraper when his family is taken hostage.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Jason Bateman and the gang return for more outrageous encounters. After the trio's new business is hampered by a sly investor, they come up with a misguided plan to kidnap him.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers
programme.desc: Owen Wilson and Vince Vaughn run this crazy comedy. A pair of friends and womanisers crash weddings to meet women. Things get complicated when one of them falls for a bridesmaid.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: A humourous satire about TV rating wars. A TV ratings computer malfunctions, inaccurately reporting that the audience prefers public television.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
